utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday the 23rd. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to the little spinning circle again?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: We've got you. More importantly, whose new car is that in the car park? Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Someone's new car, definitely not mine. Mine's the one with the permanently illuminated engine light.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's not a fault, that's mood lighting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this turns into a car clinic. Finished bits first, please.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, so I already swapped the filter on the Line 2 Safety Guard Interlock yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's finished, then? Not something still hanging over from yesterday?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Finished, yeah. Just reporting it, not putting it back on the list.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the AC1 on Tuesday. That's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Two things we don't need to go round again.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, I noticed the line three was running a bit warm on nights, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Settled before the end of nights? Sorry, you clipped a bit there.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, it settled down. Just an observation, nothing I'm raising as new work.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same sort of thing from me: heard a slight rattle from the line 1 mould temp. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observations only on those. Not treating either as an extra job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: The other one, I can't get to the gas turbine two until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Still blocked, then. We're not allocating that as work for today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Exactly. Without the window, it's not going anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the line 2 robot, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, so that isn't lurking on today's list either?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No. Off today's list. Next month, not now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Actual actions, then. Jamie Brennan, can you check the guarding on the IM3 on the 3rd? It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, just checking the guarding on the IM3, that's the scope?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: That's right, the guarding check. On the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Okay, I'll check the guarding on the IM3 on the 3rd. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And fairly important, as you said. Don't want that bit getting lost in the audio.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, fairly important. That's the priority for that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll recalibrate the sensors on the Line 3 Chiller today at 2pm. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Marc, that's an actual recalibration, rather than just comparing the readings?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, recalibrate the sensors. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, today at 2pm, Marc?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Today at 2pm, yep.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Got you. Matters, but not urgent. I heard the distinction.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Gas valve sign-off next, different priority on this one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the turbine one gas valve on the 3rd. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Saz, sorry—on the 3rd for that sign-off, yes?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, on the 3rd. Mine, and drop everything for that one. The date hasn't changed.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Understood. Date and priority are two separate bits there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marc, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team tomorrow? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Ah, no, sorry. I can't take that one as well. Haven't got the capacity to own it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Jamie, can you take that instead—organise the toolbox talk for the team tomorrow? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead. I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, I spoke over the end there. Tomorrow, not today?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Tomorrow, yeah. And understood: not an emergency, but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: One still needing an owner: take vibration readings on the turbine one compressor today. Normal priority. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I can't take it, sorry. Don't put my name against that one.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Nor me. Same capacity problem, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Can't take that on top, no.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I can't commit to that today either.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Not one I can take, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, I can't own that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I haven't got capacity for it either. So the vibration readings on the turbine one compressor are still needed today, normal priority, but nobody owns them.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, leave that visibly unowned. Better than it looking agreed to someone when it isn't.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Needed, but unallocated. No name against it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just so I've not muddled mine: guarding on the IM3 on the 3rd, fairly important. Organise the toolbox talk for the team tomorrow, not an emergency but don't let it slip. Both accepted.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And mine's recalibrate the sensors on the Line 3 Chiller today at 2pm. Matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes. And I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the turbine one gas valve on the 3rd. Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Fine. And the gas turbine two stays blocked, not quietly added to mine.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Same with the line 2 robot belt: pushed to next month. Not today's work.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. Still no confession about the new car, then.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Whoever owns it is probably pretending their microphone's broken.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Probably the sensible approach. Right, thanks all. That's us.
